$comment: Prompts for this game's art: npm run gen:asset -- xiangqi/<name> (the style in assets/prompts.json is added).

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top an oriental Chinese chess (xiangqi) board with round wooden disc pieces in red and black, a small bonsai pine tree and a stone lantern. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

board.prompt: A Chinese chess (xiangqi) playing board seen exactly from the top, flat top-down orthographic view, nearly square but slightly taller than wide (about 9:10 portrait), softly rounded outer corners: a thick glossy red-lacquered wooden rim with a thin gold trim line on its inner edge and small ornate gold corner pieces, around a large smooth light honey-colored wooden playing surface with a very subtle soft wood grain. The playing surface is completely empty and plain: no grid lines, no markings, no pieces, no text. Matches a red-lacquer card table from the same game.
